statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The monitoring is required to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The monitoring is required to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
